item.title: Why Orban and Vucic Broke With Trump on Election Denial
item.description: Rejecting President Trump’s election denial playbook, nationalist leaders in Serbia and Hungary opted for an orderly retreat.

item.title: Russia Senses Opportunity in Polish Political Turmoil
item.description: After its sometime allies were ousted in elections in Hungary and Serbia, Moscow has seized on Poland’s constitutional standoff in its effort to weaken Europe’s support for Ukraine.

item.title: Trump Removes South Africa From the African Growth and Opportunity Act Trade Program
item.description: The decision is the latest measure taken against the country, which the administration has accused of discriminating against white people.

item.title: Iran Says It Would Reopen Strait of Hormuz in 2 Days as Part of U.S. Deal
item.description: Iranian officials spoke of some progress in negotiating to reopen the strait even as they prepared for all-out war. A Qatari delegation arrived in Tehran on Monday to meet with the foreign minister to continue talks.

item.title: Trump Pushes Venezuela for Agreement Allowing U.S. Troops to Stay
item.description: The two countries have long been adversaries, and the United States attacked Venezuela this year, but Secretary of State Marco Rubio is starting talks on a legal agreement.
